diagnostics.note: Post-observation residual alerts are diagnostics, not forecasts of future events.

uncertainty.interpretation: Descriptive resampling interval; dependence and representativeness assumptions apply.

data.next_test: Freeze a new protocol and use newly collected or separately held-out observations.
data.prohibited_reuse: These test outcomes are now development evidence, not a fresh confirmation set.
data.rationale: Retain the matched conventional baseline as the working alternative; do not rewrite this result.
